source: VERBATIM (trailing comma and the doc's '...' elision in `values` removed) from https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/embeddings/get-text-embeddings and the API reference https://docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-reference/text-embeddings-api (2026-10-06). Endpoint: POST https://{REGION}-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{PROJECT}/locations/{REGION}/publishers/google/models/gemini-embedding-001:predict . 'For gemini-embedding-001, each request can only include a single input text.' parameters: { autoTruncate: bool, outputDimensionality: int }. Wire field names are snake_case here (task_type, token_count). Not reachable with an Agent Platform API key (keys cover generateContent/streamGenerateContent only).
